mi-2024-pa-181.status: Enacted as 2024 PA 181; in effect and not repealed as of 2026-07-31
mi-2024-pa-181.key_provisions: Created or expanded qualified and enterprise data center use-tax exemptions through 2050 if conditions are met.

mi-hb-4906-2023.key_provisions: Expanded sales-tax exemption framework for enterprise data centers.

mi-hb-5396-2025.key_provisions: Repeals sales-tax data-center exemption in MCL 205.54ee.

mi-hb-5397-2025.key_provisions: Repeals use-tax data-center exemption in MCL 205.94cc.

mi-hb-5398-2025.status: Introduced 2025-12-17; referred to House Committee on Economic Competitiveness; no further action as of 2026-07-31
mi-hb-5398-2025.key_provisions: Conforming property-tax change tied to repeal package.

mi-hb-5399-2025.key_provisions: Would prohibit local officials from signing NDAs related to data-center construction.

mi-hb-5594-2026.sponsors: Rep. Jennifer Wortz; cosponsors include Reps. Paquette, Fox, Miller, Wegela, Foreman, DeSana, Smit, Schriver, Byrnes, and Rigas
mi-hb-5594-2026.status: Introduced 2026-02-26; referred to House Committee on Government Operations; no further action as of 2026-07-31
mi-hb-5594-2026.key_provisions: Creates the Data Center Regulation Act; bars local units and EGLE from issuing approvals for data centers and bars new operations until 2027-04-01; civil fine up to $1,000 per day for operating violations.
